raw: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) FROM "Match" m JOIN "League" l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN "Country" c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'England' AND l.name = 'Premier League' AND m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.date >= '2015-08-01' AND m.date <= '2016-05-25'
